# lc-traffic-test-meet-2026-09-29.jsonl

LiftingCast WebSocket traffic from Self-hosted LiftingCast (the Docker image)
for one meet with two platforms during lifting, recorded with
liftingcast-clipper's `prototype/lc-tap`. One line per message: receive time,
size, raw message. 34 messages, all meet state; no server errors.
